events.title: Blood Royale
events.description:
You can participate in the Blood Royale Season Event by tapping the "Season Event" logo on the right side of the Home Screen.
• Blood Royale Season Event consists of the following activities: Event Story / Normal Battles / Challenge Battles / Fiend Hunter / Event Shop.
• You can purchase various items at the Event Shop with event currency acquired from each content.

events.title: Tower of Salvation · Season 27
events.description:
Tower of Salvation is content where you select random Costumes and collect Artifacts as you progress toward the final battle on the highest floor.
• Challenge the Tower by consuming Keys of Salvation and earn difficulty clear rewards and Night World Obsidian while growing the Blessing of the Night World.
• At the end of each Season, the difficulty records, rewards, Obsidian, and Blessing stats will be reset.
